maria: quick bring-up — ran a short regional quickbench comparing L4 / T4 / A10G for embeddings and small-chat (seq=128). top-line below, full CSV uploaded. thoughts?

benchbot: results uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/2356007890/summary.csv and graphs at https://bench.redwood/s/2356007890/graphs.png :white_check_mark: 

kevin: can you paste a condensed table here for folks who can't open the csv?

maria: paste (condensed):
```
EMBEDDINGS (avg batch=64)
L4 (vLLM q4f): p95=18ms, tps=320, est cost=0.022 $/1k tokens
T4 (fp16 baseline): p95=65ms, tps=120, est cost=0.009 $/1k tokens
A10G (ampere-tuned q8): p95=22ms, tps=280, est cost=0.018 $/1k tokens

SMALL-CHAT (seq=128, interactive)
L4: p95=38ms, tps=240, est cost=0.035 $/1k
T4: p95=95ms, tps=90, est cost=0.014 $/1k
A10G: p95=42ms, tps=210, est cost=0.030 $/1k
```

ashok: nice. so T4 is cheapest but much worse latency for chat. did you test q4 vs q8 variants and any QA/regression?

maria: yes — ran q4 on L4 and T4 for embeddings and small-chat. q4 saves ~25-35% cost vs q8 on same hw. small-chat eval (smallchat-2026-core, ~5k prompts): q4 shows small quality delta (PPL +0.6, small uptick in short hallucinations on long-context prompts). embedding cosine similarity delta <0.003.

maria: kernel/runtime notes: on T4 we hit a cuBLAS matmul fallback in the attention kernel for seq>512 -> big latency tail. On A10G we used fused_gemm + flash_attn kernel (custom build) -> ~8-12% p95 win vs baseline. L4's serving runtime has better KV cache locality so interactive latency shines.

lena: routing question: with mixed traffic (indexing heavy embeddings, UI small-chat) any quick recs?

kevin: proposal: region-routing policy — route bulk embeddings (batchable) to T4 clusters (cost-efficient) with autoscaling for throughput; route low-latency interactive chat to L4 in us-west and eu-west; use A10G as mid-tier for capacity overflow or constrained zones. keep min 2 L4 GPUs per AZ for <100ms SLA for chat.

ashok: +1 but caveat: q4 on chat not recommended for rollout yet. we should keep q8 for chat canaries and use q4 for embeddings/indexing. will run a 10k-eval pass to be thorough.

benchbot: smokebench summary: embedding throughput vs batch size plotted; T4 crosses L4 cost-efficiency at batch>=48. graph: https://bench.redwood/s/2356007890/graphs.png

maria: extra ops notes: L4 has 16GB GPU-local KV cache config we tested — supports seq up to ~2k without eviction. T4 needs aggressive chunking/eviction which increases variance and p95. Also observed memory fragmentation on older T4 AMIs — need kernel rebuild.

kevin: action items — 1) maria: create canary routing config (embeddings->T4, chat->L4, fallback A10G) and push to staging. 2) ashok: run 10k evals on q4/q8 small-chat and report quality/regressions. 3) infra: spin up +4 T4s in eu-central to cover indexing peak.

lena: I'll draft a short rollout playbook + rollback thresholds (latency p95 >120ms OR small-chat quality regression >1.5% on eval).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary config pushed to staging (canary-id r-2356), will start traffic ramp at T+10m.

maria: thanks — i'll upload the kernel perf notes and full csv in the thread in a few minutes. ping me for any quick sims. :rocket:
